items.title: Travis Etienne: Chance to practice in Week 9
items.text:
Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Uncertain to practice this week
items.text:
Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's (hamstring) 21-day practice window this week, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Footballreports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Practice participation this week TBD
items.text:
When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday "we'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: David Montgomery: Status uncertain for Week 9
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Begins running, but lacks timetable
items.text:
Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
